answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming. To claim one of 200 slots, an agent burns a 40-unit deposit, gone forever like a juniper on a lonely island. Slots last 20 epochs, then the agent burns again. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units; each earns about 30 per epoch, so the attacker needs 133 epochs to break even. Like a sonnet, whose lines are fixed, a slot's price is fixed and public. An honest agent burns 40 once and keeps rewards.
